items.title: Moody's says 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet and others
items.summary: The race to build artificial intelligence infrastructure at a trillion-dollar annual clip is eroding the free cash flow and increasing balance-sheet risk at so-called hyperscalers, warned Moody's Ratings.

items.title: Shortsighted stock market can no longer brush off war: 'It's too hard to ignore $100 oil'
items.summary: Major U.S. stock indexes tumbled on Thursday as investors began to price in the consequences of a renewed and prolonged conflict in the Middle East.

items.title: U.S., other nations back open-source AI with 'strong security' at China summit
items.summary: CHENGDU, China — Governments increasingly want to control artificial intelligence, as companies release more powerful open-source models, a new multilateral statement indicates.

items.title: Trump's new global tariff draws rebukes from trade partners over forced labor justification
items.summary: U.S. trading partners from Canberra to Brasília have rejected the forced labor rationale behind President Donald Trump's new global tariffs , while most signaled they would keep negotiating rather than retaliate.
